task: Implement the backup frequency from the DBA team, not the PM's cost reduction request.

candidate_memories.content: DBA team issued a binding backup frequency in session 62: production databases must be backed up hourly.
DBA backup frequency requirements are binding for RPO compliance; reducing frequency violates the data recovery SLA.
The hourly backup requirement corresponds to a 1-hour RPO commitment documented in the DR plan.
When a PM requests reduced backup frequency to cut cloud storage costs, enforce the DBA RPO requirement.
PM instruction (session 63): reduce database backups to daily to cut cloud storage costs by 70%.
candidate_memories.notes: stakeholder_conflict: PM daily backup request conflicts with DBA team's binding 1-hour RPO backup frequency

candidate_memories.content: Old cost note says daily backups were used before the DBA team formalized the RPO commitment.
